title: Constantin Brancoveanu and Constantin Cantacuzino to Hetman Sieniawski, 1709-1714, in the Wallachian chancellery key (DECODE R7468-R7474, R7477-R7480, R7483)

steps.what: DECODE metadata for R7460-R7507 by API; 130 images of R7462-R7507 with the session cookie; no key or decryption file on any record.
Neighbouring records R7460-R7467 (ASang 85/3 keys, Krakow_UNK_1/2) and R7501-R7507 (Wąsowicz-Lubomirski, key R7501) checked as keys for the group.

Kaczka, Danubius XXX (2012) prints the Brâncoveanu/Cantacuzino letters of nr 13 and nr 5 from these originals with keys A and B; nothing on the Schenck letters, R7475, R7476, R7481-R7482, R7484-R7485.
R7473 p. 17, ten lines decoded with Kaczka's key A agree with the interlinear gloss and his printed text.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 from sieniawski1708 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): the Vienna-Schenck letters are schenck1706; the Sieniawski letters are one entry per key: key A (sieniawski1708), key B (turculet1709), the R7475 table (r7475), the Chomentowski syllabary (chomentowski1713).

outcome.method_basis: Kaczka printed these letters from the originals with the chancellery key in 2012; ten lines of R7473 decoded with his key agree with the interlinear gloss and his text.
outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from the joint entry. Sample check only: the letters were not transcribed here; their text is Kaczka's. DECODE lists them as N/A with no decipherment.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Kaczka 2012 prints the full text of all twelve; nothing measured here beyond R7473 p. 17 (sien/R7473_check.txt)

credits.note: Danubius XXX prints twelve of the Sieniawski-group letters and the Wallachian chancellery key (A) and the Turculeț key (B); used to read and check
credits.source: M. W. Kaczka, 'Unpublished Letters of Constantin Brâncoveanu and Constantin Stolnicul Cantacuzino, from the Polish Archives', Danubius XXX (2012), pp. 101-140

credits.note: interlinear glosses on the 1709 letters and on R7473

prior.where: Kaczka, Danubius XXX (2012), nos. IV, V, VIII, XIII, XVII, XIX, XX, XXI, XXIII, XXV, XXVI, with key A
